description:
Ensure your toddler sleeps soundly and safely with the Full-Length Guard Rail from Old Time Oak. Designed to fit OTO convertible cribs in toddler or full-size bed mode, this rail runs the entire length of the bed for maximum security.
The guard rail is crafted from solid wood with a durable finish that matches your Old Time Oak furniture. Simple attachment hardware makes installation quick and tool-free. The full-length design provides complete protection along the open side of the bed, giving you confidence that your child will stay safely in bed all night long.
When your child is ready to sleep without the rail, it removes cleanly without affecting the appearance of your furniture. Sturdy enough for active sleepers yet gentle on your furniture, this guard rail is an essential accessory for the transition years. Non-toxic, baby-safe finish.
